claims: LNG is natural gas cooled to approximately −162°C (−260°F).
LNG is a colorless, non-toxic liquid.
Liquefaction reduces the volume of natural gas by 600 times.
LNG is primarily used for international energy shipping, power generation, and industrial fuel.
LNG is the liquid form of natural gas.
LNG is condensed for transport via ships to areas not served by pipelines.
LNG is regasified upon arrival for use.
LNG can be transported overseas in specialized carriers.
LNG can be stored at low pressure.
LNG is used in power generation.
LNG is used in manufacturing.
LNG is used in mining.
LNG is used as a transportation fuel for ships.
LNG is used as a transportation fuel for heavy-duty trucks.
LNG produces lower sulphur emissions compared to coal or heavy fuel oils.
LNG produces lower greenhouse gas emissions compared to coal or heavy fuel oils.
LNG is a fossil fuel.
LNG is non-flammable in liquid form.
LNG poses fire and freezing risks after vaporization.
LNG is used by utility companies for power generation.
LNG is used by industries for fuel.
LNG is used for peak shaving.
Peak shaving involves storing LNG and using it during high-demand periods.
Methane emissions occur from LNG production, shipping, and regasification.
The EU focuses on regulating the full life cycle of marine fuels to reduce emissions.
